matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Anchor boxes introduce many hyperparameters and a large gap between positive and negative samples that complicates training of dense detectors.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: FCOS completely avoids hyper-parameters related to anchor boxes.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: A center-ness branch suppresses low-quality predictions far from the object center, recovering accuracy lost by removing anchor heuristics.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The center-ness branch improves AP from 33.5% to 37.1%.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: FCOS performs object detection in a per-pixel fashion directly on the feature map, predicting class and bounding-box offsets at each location without anchor boxes.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: FCOS is an anchor box free and proposal free object detector.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: FCOS surpasses anchor-based detectors such as RetinaNet on COCO without requiring anchor box hyperparameter tuning.
